reason: A read-only usage analytics plugin that calculates DeepSeek API cost estimates from session event logs and presents session-level and global breakdowns in the interface.

summaries.zh: 根据会话事件日志估算 DeepSeek API 费用，并在界面中展示会话级和全局费用统计。
summaries.en: Estimates DeepSeek API costs from session event logs and displays session-level and global usage statistics in the interface.

capabilities: Replays persistent session events to calculate estimated API costs
Aggregates costs by session, pricing period, and supported model
Displays session and global cost statistics in the user interface
